notes.title: Game Update v5.1.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Tank Battle: Blitzkrieg update v3.2.1
notes.content:
Add: Added the Panzer IIc, replacing the Panzer IIf in most missions.
Change: Updated the play balance in a number of missions.
Fix: An issue with ending the 'Maginot Defense' mission.
Update: Some German transport vehicles to Sd.Kfz 7's.
Update: Some other minor graphical updates.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Blitzkrieg - Update 3.2.0
notes.content:
Added the Panzer IIc, replacing the Panzer IIf in most missions.
Change: Updated the play balance in a number of missions.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Blitzkrieg Update v3.1.0
notes.content:
Change: Reduced the tree density on some map hexes.
Fix: Some terrain was not providing cover against shooting, as per the terrain effects chart.
Fix: Some woodland hexes were incorrectly allowing units to pass through them in a single movement action.

notes.title: Tank Battle: Blitzkrieg - version 3.0.5 update
notes.content:
Change: The Bonus 'Blitzkrieg' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
Fix: The campaign names did not always display correctly in the campaign victory display.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the maginot forts which in some cases resulted in the player not able to target them.

Any issues let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Update.
notes.content:
Add: 6 Mission 'North Africa' Campaign, playing as the British.

notes.title: Command & Colors: The Great War released!
notes.content:
HexWar Games has partnered with Plastic Soldier Company to bring you a digital version of Command & Colors: The Great War board game. The game allow players to portray important engagements throughout WWI history. The battles focus on the historical deployment of forces and important terrain features of trench fighting in scale with the game system.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/449460/
